Frequently asked questions

How much does it cost to sign up?

Nothing. Sign-up is free with no commitment. You only pay a commission (15–20%, your choice) on bookings you receive.

Can I stay on Booking and Airbnb?

Yes. You link your calendars and StayInRiad keeps them in sync automatically to avoid double bookings.

When do I get paid?

Every Monday, by bank transfer in dirhams, for stays that ended the previous week.

What documents do I need?

Your company details (company name, ICE, trade register, tourism operating licence) and a bank account (RIB) in the company's name.
